concerns.text: SC-006 requires that when normalized_count < 100 the system halt only the PRIMARY regression and 'proceed only to the sensitivity analysis (FR-011) if total_count >= 100'. T004's compare_thresholds exits 1 (full halt) whenever normalized < 100, and no other task implements the degraded path where T008's sensitivity analysis still runs. The SC-006 graceful-degradation branch has no covering task.

FR-014 requires that on power < 0.8 the system 'switch to a simpler model (Linear Regression) or report a power_insufficiency warning'. T004 only computes and records reports/power_analysis.json; T006 trains all three models unconditionally with no task wiring the power result into model selection or emitting the warning. The FR-014 action branch is uncovered.

SC-001 requires the best model's test R² to be 'measured against the baseline Linear Regression R² to quantify the improvement from non-linear modeling'. T006 reports only the single best model's metrics; no task computes or records the Linear Regression baseline R² or the improvement delta, so SC-001's comparison evidence is never produced.

No task produces any artifact conforming to output.schema.yaml (it defines fields like bootstrap_ci_lower/upper, loco_insufficient_samples, analysis_stage that appear nowhere in T001–T014). The contract is orphaned relative to the task list; either a task must emit an output.schema.yaml-conforming artifact or the contract should be retired.

concerns.location: tasks.md vs plan.md:Constitution Check III / constitution.md:Data Hygiene
concerns.text: Plan Constitution Check III and the constitution mandate checksumming raw data on download with checksums recorded in state/projects/...yaml. No task in T001–T014 computes checksums or updates the state file; T002 only writes merged.csv and source_validation.json. Constitution III coverage is missing.

The constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at code/ from which the isolated venv is built. No task creates or pins this file; T001 establishes main.py/seed.py/schema_map.json but not the dependency manifest.
